title: Finite Element Analysis of Mineral Trioxide Aggregate-Repaired Root Perforations in Post-and-core Restored Teeth: Effects of Perforation Size, Location, and Loading Direction on Stress Distribution
html: Root lateral perforation repair may restore structural continuity, but the biomechanical behavior of perforated teeth restored with post-and-core systems under different perforation sizes, anatomical locations, and functional loading conditions remains unclear.
